back_translation: Thus says the LORD to His anointed one, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped, to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their weapons from their waists, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:
"I will go before you and level the rough places. I will break down the bronze doors and cut through the iron bars.
I will give you the treasures of darkness and the hoards hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by your name.
For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I have called you by your name; I have given you a title of honor, though you do not know Me.
I am the LORD, and there is no other; besides Me there is no God. I will gird you with strength, though you do not know Me,
so that from the rising of the sun to its setting they may know that there is none besides Me. I am the LORD, and there is no other.
I form light and create darkness; I make peace and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
"Drip down, O heavens above; let the clouds pour down righteousness. Let the earth open so that salvation may sprout, and let righteousness spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.
Woe to him who quarrels with the one who formed him — a mere potsherd among the potsherds on the ground. Can the clay say to the potter, 'What are you making?' Or can the work say, 'He has no skill'?
Woe to him who says to a father, 'What have you begotten?' or to a mother, 'What have you given birth to?'"
Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, who formed him: "Concerning things to come, will you question Me about My children? Will you give Me orders about the work of My hands?
I Myself made the earth and created mankind upon it. My own hands stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their starry host.
I Myself have aroused him in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free — without payment or reward," says the LORD of Hosts.

Thus says the LORD: "The produce of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the tall Sabeans, will come over to you and will be yours. They will walk behind you; they will come in chains and bow down before you. They will plead with you, saying, 'Surely God is among you, and there is no other; there is no other God.'"
Truly You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.
All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced together; they will walk in humiliation together.
But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will never be put to shame or disgraced, forever and ever.

For thus says the LORD who created the heavens — He is God — who formed the earth and made it, who established it; He did not create it to be empty waste, but formed it to be inhabited: "I am the LORD, and there is no other.
I have not spoken in secret, in some place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, 'Seek Me in emptiness.' I, the LORD, speak the truth; I declare what is right.
"Assemble and come, you fugitives from the nations; draw near together. Those who carry around their wooden idols know nothing; they pray to a god who cannot save.

Declare and present your case — indeed, let them consult together. Who announced this long ago? Who declared it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? And there is no God besides Me — a righteous God and Savior; there is none except Me.
Turn to Me and be saved, all you ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.
I have sworn by Myself; a word has gone out from My mouth in righteousness, a word that will not return: that to Me every knee will bow and every tongue will swear allegiance.
They will say of Me, 'Righteousness and strength are found in the LORD alone.'" All who raged against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
In the LORD all the offspring of Israel will be justified, and they will glory in Him.
